title: Two small factors and one large
plain: Add the smallest prime factors of n and n + 1 to the largest prime factor of n + 2. Every tested start falls into one seven-step loop through 16. Prove all do.
math: For $f(n)=p(n)+p(n+1)+P(n+2)$, prove every orbit with $n\ge2$ reaches $(16,22,28,36,58,66,86)$.
